text:
anya: Heads-up — I ran GPTQ bakeoff across Llama/Mistral/Qwen on the v2 eval harness. Seeing a reproducible drop for Mistral-7B GPTQ-4bit on QA+long-context tasks. Can we triage?

miguel: Which metrics/sets? quick numbers please.

anya: NaturalQuestions EM -3.2% vs fp16 baseline, TriviaQA -2.1%, perplexity +0.9. Latency slightly better (~-6ms) but accuracy loss is concerning. Run was `gptq-4bit-per-channel` quant on ckpt `mistral-7b-v1`.

kevin: @anya can you paste the eval-bot summary? also did you use KV cache warmup?

anya: pasted below from eval-bot. KV warmup = yes (50 steps). Model compiled with kernel set A.

eval-bot: ```SUMMARY:
models: [llama-7b-gptq4, mistral-7b-gptq4, qwen-7b-gptq4]
datasets: [natural_questions, trivia_qa, longbench-qa]
metrics: EM/Accuracy/Perplexity
results:
  llama-7b-gptq4: NQ EM -0.5%, Trivia +0.1%, ppx +0.2
  mistral-7b-gptq4: NQ EM -3.2%, Trivia -2.1%, ppx +0.9
  qwen-7b-gptq4: NQ EM -0.8%, Trivia -0.4%, ppx +0.3
notes: mistral drop concentrated on long-context examples and multi-hop reasoning.```

lia: interesting. any difference between per-channel vs per-tensor quant? maybe outliers in weight distribution for Mistral.

anya: I used per-channel. I'll rerun per-tensor and awq-style asymmetric quant next.

miguel: hypothesis: fused attention kernels in the Mistral runtime may rely on FP accumulation paths that GPTQ maps differently — could be a dequantization bias for certain heads. Also check layernorm eps sensitivity.

kevin: can you add a quick smoke: run the same GPTQ profile but with `layernorm-eps=1e-6` vs `1e-5` and no fused kernels flag to see if it narrows.

anya: queued jobs: 1) per-tensor GPTQ 2) AWQ-4bit 3) GPTQ+layernorm-eps variants 4) disable-fused-attn compile. ETA ~2hrs.

lia: also add evaluation on our unit prompt set that isolates knowledge vs reasoning. If drop is only on multi-hop -> routing policy for canary: keep fp16 for long-context customers.

miguel: +1. Ops: mark mistral-gptq4 as DO NOT PROMOTE in rollout until we have baseline parity on qa/regression test. I'll update the canary config.

kevin: is this likely to affect embeddings or only generation?

anya: embeddings unaffected (we didn't quantize embed-only layers), generator logits appear shifted on head 10-12 mostly.

eval-bot: quick follow-up run (per-tensor) finished:
```results:
  mistral-7b-gptq4-pertensor: NQ EM -1.0%, Trivia -0.7%, ppx +0.4
```

anya: per-tensor reduced the gap but didn't eliminate it. AWQ run in progress.

lia: good signal. that suggests quant granularity matters. Could be activation range outliers in specific layers. Next steps: collect per-layer clipping stats and compare ckpt histograms.

kevin: can someone run `collect-quant-stats --model mistral-7b --profile gptq-4bit` and upload histograms to /mnt/eval/artifacts/1995012345/ ?

anya: started that job. uploading when done.

miguel: FYI operational note: if we can't reach parity, consider shipping mixed-profile: default GPTQ-4bit for <1k tokens, fallback fp16 for >1k or when route tag long-context=true. That preserves cost while avoiding regressions.

anya: agreed. I'll draft a rollback/canary flag to the deployment config.

kevin: thanks. once AWQ results are in, let's sync for an hour to decide promotion strategy. :thumbsup:

anya: AWQ finished -> eval-bot summary:
```results:
  mistral-7b-awq4: NQ EM -0.6%, Trivia -0.3%, ppx +0.25
  notes: AWQ significantly better on multi-hop, suggests quant algorithm (asymmetric scaling) helps.```

lia: AWQ looks promising. can we run latency/throughput benchmarks for AWQ vs GPTQ per-batch (bs=1,4,16) and check memory OOM behavior?

anya: added perf jobs. initial numbers: AWQ latency ~+3ms vs GPTQ4 but still -12ms vs fp16; mem usage similar to GPTQ; throughput slightly lower at bs=16.

miguel: decision: block promotion of Mistral-GPTQ4; continue AWQ exploration. Add per-model quant profiles: prefer AWQ for mistral, GPTQ for llama/qwen unless further regressions show up.

anya: I'll update the bakeoff doc and add an actionable checklist (collect histograms, layer-level diffs, rerun with different eps, produce perf matrix). Will ping when done.

kevin: thanks team. tagging this thread in the bakeoff dashboard and will add a short note to release notes: "Mistral: prefer AWQ4 for now; GPTQ4 requires further validation on long-context QA." :white_check_mark:
